h: Jay-Z praises daughter Blue Ivy after she joins him on stage on piano
p: Jay-Z reportedly bowed to his 14-year-old daughter, Blue Ivy, and hyped her up when she joined him on stage and performed on the piano. Clips of the moment are said to be circulating widely online.
more: Blue Ivy has increasingly appeared on stage with her parents in recent years.
Fans online praised the father-daughter moment.
